attributes.name: Ellen M Pawlikowski
attributes.blurb: Retired as Commander, U.S. Air Force Material Command
attributes.summary:
Pawlikowski retired as Commander, U.S. Air Force Material Command, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in 2018. She entered the U.S. Air Force in 1978 through the ROTC program at the New Jersey Institute of Technology. 

Her career spanned a wide variety of technical management, leadership and staff positions, including command at the wing and center levels. She has served as director of the acquisition management office for the Assistant to the Secretary of Defense for Atomic Energy.
